title: Docs: Edit JSON button is now accessible at 320x256 viewport (WCAG 2.1 Reflow test)
body:
Closes #24149 

Edit JSON button is now accessible at 320x256 viewport (WCAG 2.1 Reflow test).                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ## Changes Made                                                                                                                                                                           
  - Added EditIcon to the Edit JSON button                                                                                                                                                  
  - Changed button layout from position:absolute to flex layout                                                                                                                             
  - Added media query to hide text on screens < 400px, showing only icon                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ## Related Issue                                                                                                                                                                          
  Fixes #24149                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                            
  ## Checklist                                                                                                                                                                              
  - [x] Code compiles without errors                                                                                                                                                        
  - [x] TypeScript check passes                                                                                                                                                             
  - [x] Lint passes 

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Edit button now shows an icon alongside its label for clearer affordance.
  * Added small-viewport examples demonstrating control behavior on narrow screens.

* **Style**
  * Button label hides on very small screens while keeping the icon visible for better mobile usability.
  * Controls reflow vertically on narrow screens with adjusted spacing and alignment.

* **Accessibility**
  * Improved handling of hidden labels to better support assistive technologies.

comments.label_reasoning: Completely hiding text visually breaks screen reader accessibility, meaning the code's behavior deviates from the intended accessible UX. The fix involves using sr-only styles to preserve screen reader announcements while hiding text visually.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags an accessibility issue with hiding text from screen readers and requests a specific fix using the `sb-sr-only` / `srOnlyStyles` approach, with a code example.

comments.author: Sidnioulz
comments.body: There's a specific size where shenanigans like this happen because you set flex direction only on media width and not container width. I've removed the column direction entirely in my commit.
comments.label_reasoning: The flex direction was only applied conditionally on media width but not container width, causing layout issues at certain viewport sizes — a logic/condition error in the responsive styling implementation.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Identifies a visual layout bug caused by setting flex direction only on media width and not container width, and notes a fix was applied — implying the original code needs to be changed.
